What OIG Found Ohio could better ensure that nursing homes in Ohio that participate in the Medicare or Medicaid programs comply with Federal requirements for life safety, emergency preparedness, and infection control if additional resources were available. During our onsite inspections, we identified deficiencies related to life safety, emergency preparedness, or infection control at 18 of the 20 nursing homes that we audited, totaling 160 deficiencies. Specifically, we found 47 deficiencies related to life safety, 47 deficiencies related to emergency preparedness, and 66 deficiencies related to infection control.
